transcript.text: Our AC is out and it is 98 degrees upstairs. I have a newborn baby. Yes. 88 Meridian Way, San Jose, 9520 Faye.
My name is Dana Whitfield. My phone is 408-555-0142. No one is hurt, but please hurry.
Thanks for calling Summit Heating and Air. This is Maya, the virtual assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?

I'll treat this as urgent. If anyone is at risk from the heat, call 911. I'll create an emergency ticket and get our on-call HVAC technician. To pass this to our on-call technician, please give me your name, service address and callback number.
I couldn't reach the on-call technician. Your emergency ticket is open and someone will call you back within 15 minutes. If anything gets worse, call 911.
